title: Maria G NDE 101
content:
I WAS TOLD AFTERWARDS THAT I WAS DYING AND MY SONS WERE CALLED TO MY BEDSIDE. I WAS IN A COMA. IN THE EXPERIENCE, I WAS TRANSPORTED VERY FAST THROUGH A TUNNEL. SO MUCH SO THAT I COULD FEEL THE SENSATION OF BEING PULLED THROUGH ON MY ARMS AND LEGS. AT THE END OF THE TUNNEL THERE WERE BRIGHT OVERHEAD LIGHTS. I WENT THROUGH THE LIGHT, AND WAS IN A RED BRICK ROOM (WALLS AND FLOOR). IT WAS VERY COLD AND MY FEET WERE FREEZING. I WAS IN FRONT OF JESUS CHRIST AND BEHIND HIM WERE MY DECEASED FATHER AND PATERNAL GRANDMOTHER IN THE CLOTHES WE BURIED THEM IN. IT WAS LIKE AN EL GRECO PAINTING. EVERYONE WAS VERY SOMBER AND SERIOUS. CHRIST ASKED ME IF I WAS READY TO DIE AND I RESPONDED, ‘YES’. HE SAID YOU HAVE TO GO BACK BECAUSE OF YOUR SON CHRISTOPHER (AGE 20 AT THE TIME AND LIVING WITH ME). MY GRANDMOTHER WAS PRAYING THE ROSARY IN ITALIAN IN A LOW VOICE. MY FATHER NEVER SAID A WORD AND LOOKED VERY SAD AND SERIOUS. I TOLD CHRIST HE HAS A BROTHER AND SISTER-IN-LAW, AND JESUS JUST SHOOK HIS HEAD NO. WITH THAT I WAS RETURNED TO THE TUNNEL, PULLED THROUGH BACK AND WOKE UP IN MY HOSPITAL BED. WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS, I IMPROVED VASTLY AND LEFT THE HOSPITAL IN A FEW DAYS MUCH TO THE ASTONISHMENT OF MY SONS.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt being pulled through on her arms and legs.

arrival.other_being_detail: Deceased father and paternal grandmother behind Jesus, in the clothes they were buried in; grandmother praying the rosary in Italian in a low voice; father silent, sad and serious.

environment.environment_other_detail: A red brick room (walls and floor) with bright overhead lights; it was very cold and her feet were freezing.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: In a coma; told afterwards she was dying.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel movement with bright overhead lights at the end; went through the light into a red brick room; encountered Jesus and deceased father and grandmother; told to go back because of her son; returned via the tunnel and woke in the hospital bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Setting described as a red brick room (walls and floor), very cold with freezing feet; scene 'like an El Greco painting'; grandmother praying the rosary in Italian in a low voice.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Christ asked me if I was ready to die and I responded, ‘YES’. He said you have to go back because of your son Christopher.”
